prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1382; do not mention it.)
text:
This office represents the claimant in connection with a motor vehicle collision that occurred when the at-fault vehicle struck our client's vehicle while our client was turning left. Our client has sustained injuries as a result of this collision and is pursuing a claim for compensation.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company has already made contact with our client, please let us know.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to your insured, along with a copy of the declarations page. Please also confirm in writing that your company and your insured will preserve all evidence relating to the collision, including vehicle data, photographs, witness statements, dash camera footage, repair records, and claim file materials.

We look forward to your prompt response.
